jobs_results.description:
¿Dónde vas a trabajar?

Multinational Financial Services Company (Banking Sector)

¿Qué harás en tu nuevo puesto?

The IT Project Manager / PMO will have responsibility over the governance and Ccntrol of all the entity's projects as PMO, guaranteeing continuous monitoring of both the plan and, the environment that may affect it.

Development of the methodology described in the entity's Project Management Framework, guaranteeing its application by all areas involved in project development. Continuous improvement of project management FW based on the lessons learned.

Specific Duties and Responsibilities
• Inventory of project requests provided by business areas.
• Validation of project proposals, ensuring that they have the necessary detail for their understanding by the development areas (technical / functional, internal / external).
• Evaluation and scoring of projects according to the criteria defined for their prioritization.
• Consolidation of the project list and presentation to... the Project Management Committee for approval and prioritization. Monitor analytics and metrics results.
• Streamlining of planning sessions and planning development considering Business and IT times.
• Management of project documentation (requests, functional documents, risks, test cases...)
• Loading of projects, planning and maintenance in the project management tool.
• Project monitoring sessions, according to the prioritization criteria of each one. Leadership of this sessions and updating.
• Identification of project risks and coordination of the definition of mitigating actions with the Project Owner.
• Definition and monitoring of project success KPIs.
• Maintaining an inventory of lessons learned for each project

¿A quién buscamos (H/M/D)?

The IT Project Manager / PMO will be pro-active, professional, with a strong leadership and communication skills as well organized and able to work under pressure.

Proven track record for planning, executing, controlling, and closing projects and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with minimal supervision.

Experience of managing the complete lifecycle.

Details:
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, Management Information Systems, Business, or related field.
• Strong skills in creating and maintaining projects and programme plans, including risks, actions, issues, and dependencies.
• A minimum of 5+ years experience performing project management role on complex projects. Use of agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban)
• Knowledge of benefits and dependency mapping, risk management and resource planning.
• Excellent written/oral communication skills for reports and presentations.
• Ability to communicate and interact at all levels of the organisation.
• Focus on our customer relationships and impact on customer service.

Tools:
• Microsoft: Office 365, Teams, Project, Sharepoint.
• Project Management: Zoho Projects, JIRA (or similar)

¿Cuáles son tus beneficios?

Interesting professional opportunity

A little bit about Flanks

Flanks is a Barcelona-based fintech company focused on wealth management services. Its main product is a SaaS solution that helps financial advisors, family offices and other institutions to have a holistic view of their clients’ financial assets while using the latest scraping technology. We’re currently building the benchmark in the OpenWealth industry, and so far we managed to have compatibility with over 250 national and international entities.

Thanks to our clients, we continue to grow at a fast pace. We have already more than 300,000 aggregated portfolios spread across nearly 250 entities and have positioned our business at break-even in less than a year. In August 2021, Flanks raised €2.3 million in an investment round led by JME Ventures and SeedRocket 4Founders Capital. And a significant €7.5 million in August 2023, demonstrating confidence in our vision and capabilities.

We are pioneers in our market in Spain, which will certainly grow a lot in... the next few months and years. However, we are going to take a league leap in terms of the volumetry of the system, as our key focus now is to accelerate our market expansion in Europe and LatAm. And we would like to count on you to also grow (personally and professionally) with us.

Flanks’s values are:
• People first: To us, the most important thing is for “Flankers” to feel at ease, for them to get involved in a project and be feel part of the team.
• Keep growing: Our team believes that people growing in lockstep with the company is essential, both personally and professionally.
• Think twice, act once: We like to think about all the possible consequences before taking any decision that could affect the team or our clients.

If you’re looking to grow professionally in a very fast-growing company with an exciting start-up culture, this is your opportunity!
About the role

As a Junior Project Manager on our team, you will be part of the team ensuring the successful onboarding of new clients. You will be in contact with customers on the initial steps of their relationship with Flanks, and we expect you to become an expert on how Flanks work. As the primary point of contact for clients implementing integration solutions, in this role you will be responsible for managing client expectations, planning, monitoring, controlling, and reporting on the onboarding project to meet agreed deliverables, scheduled timeframes, and allocated budgets.
Responsibilities

Examples of tasks you can expect to work on are:

• Monitor and manage the client relationship and satisfaction while in the onboarding process

• Develop, monitor, and manage a master implementation schedule/project plan in the standard tools to ensure delivery of defined scope

• Keep up-to-date progress on the project in standard artefacts to ensure accurate reporting and issue management

• Identify internal resources necessary for the success of the project

• Coordinate with the members of other teams responsible for the successful implementation of the different tasks of the projects to ensure business goals and objectives are accomplished efficiently within designated timeframes, efficiency metrics and budgets.

• Work collaboratively with other departments impacting the project

• Ensure a quality implementation and transition to service with the appropriate client service team(s)/member(s).

• Organize and lead meetings with key stakeholders as needed to review project status and discuss issues, risk, resolutions, possible mitigation plan and workaround as needed.

• Assess, manage, resolve, and escalate (if necessary) risks and issues

• Prioritize and make decisions based on information and input in a timely manner

• Support communications on methodology, business process improvements and lessons learned for continuous improvement

Things we'd love to see on you

• Fluency in French (oral and written) are mandatory. Spanish and/or English will be highly valued

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, with a results-oriented approach

• Project Management Skills and some experience of managing scope, timeframes, stakeholders, resources to achieve objectives

• Proven track record of successfully managing projects, preferably with a focus on onboarding new initiatives

• Demonstrated ability to manage client interactions (e.g. negotiations, escalations) and to create client facing materials which simplify complex solutions

• Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and maintain a high level of adaptability in a fast-paced startup environment

• Tech-savvy

• Understanding of International culture and ability to work in a multinational environment. Ability to tailor communications to various cultures and learning styles

• Understanding of fintech products, services, and industry trends will be valued

What can we offer

We offer fair compensation. We're not on top of the market, but our intention is to increase compensation as the company grows, you will not be left behind. Likewise, we believe this is a really nice time to join the project as we have a lot of challenges ahead and you'll be an active part of this exciting journey. This is a full-time, permanent contract. We offer hybrid work, so you’ll be asked to come work in-office for some time every week.

A non-exhaustive list of perks includes:

🏠 Office between Sants Estació and Plaça Espanya, with a 280 degree view of Barcelona.

🔆 Flexible working hours

🎊 Paid time off on your birthday

🍒 Fresh fruit every week, all-you-can-drink tea and coffee

🍻 Friday happy hours after our weekly team meetings (optional)

😎 Team building events (optional)

🙀 Personal holidays swap inside the same month

🍽️ Digital canteen with Nora in our offices subsidized at 50%.

🏥 Health insurance

💸 Flexible remuneration with Cobee

📚 Yearly training budget
The hiring process

This is how the usual hiring process looks like:
• You send us your resume and cover letter.
• Will ask you to answer some questions based on a use case.
• A chat with our Head of Project Management, Lamia Boukhibra, where we’ll dive deeper into your background, your possible fit. You’ll also have the opportunity to ask any sort of questions.
• A cultural fit meeting with our CEO, Joaquim de la Cruz.
• Optionally, any other meeting you or us might need to clarify any pending questions.
• We send you an offer.

We expect a few days to pass between each step. We aim for a process as short as one week and never longer than one month.

If you think you meet most of the criteria described above, don’t hesitate to send us your CV and/or cover letter. We will be happy to hear from you!

Flanks is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion both in our hiring practices and in our experiences as a Flanks employee. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage all applicants regardless of race, religion, or belief (if any), nationality, ethnic or national origin, gender, gender identity, pregnancy and maternity, sexual orientation, age, marital and civil partnership status, or disability status

jobs_results.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Media.Monks is looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead multiple projects, work streams and campaigns for an iconic automotive brand. Your well-rounded experience in the trenches allows you to accurately scope, quote, upsell and set up new projects comfortably, whilst actively steering client teams and mentoring your team. You understand the differences between creative, adaptation and always-on workflows, and know how to drive operational excellence and manage large structural changes whilst staying calm, poised and positive.
Role & Responsibilities
• Key point of contact for local client teams: you understand business KPIs and drive meetings, overall communications, and successful client relationships. You are the first point of contact for client escalations.
• You run several medium to large parallel projects independently, graciously steering clients and internal teams from end-to-end across multiple work streams.
• You create accurate and realistic project scopes and... budgets, and sense check those put together by more junior team members. You track project invoicing.
• Once a new job is awarded, you help to turn pitches into projects, liaising between our creatives and makers throughout the process.
• Conduct post-mortems with the client to improve the operations and communications on a continuous basis.
• Liaise with media agencies and external partners. Aligning across agencies to create fully integrated campaigns across all touch points.
• Build close-knit and trusted working relationships with clients, external agencies and internal teams.
• Brief legal, production and language & culture teams. Ensuring the team is clear on specs, deadlines, scope, and any client or local market requirements.
• Forecast and plan resources with great responsibility.
• Contribute to presentation and decks, and proactively flag opportunities to upsell services or increase scope of work.
• Support in the recruitment of new team members.
• Mentor, guide and help onboard Jr team members to the team.
Requirements
• 5+ years of experience in coordinating projects and teams for large multinational brands in creative production or agencies. Automotive experience is a strong plus, but not a must.
• Clear understanding of the full integrated production lifecycle and the difference between Creative, Social, Adaptation and Always-On work streams.
• Managing demanding clients and high complexity situations come naturally to you.
• Proven track-record working on integrated productions from TVCs and video, through to print and digital. You know how to work with media agencies, local clearance bodies, Legal, QA and Finance teams.
• Able to seamlessly safeguard quality, scope, timelines and budgets. You have a track-record of accurate and profitable estimates, and lead projects with great care, organisation and confidence.
• Team player and self-starter with an unbreakable positive mindset who comfortably takes the lead. You take charge and consistently showcase a strong sense of responsibility.
• Clear and strong communication skills in English, and any local language. Proactive and direct way of communicating across cross-cultural teams.
• An attentive, authentic and natural mentor, you create a fun team dynamic and make sure that successes are celebrated.
• A strong sense of urgency, you never leave problems unaddressed. Critical, curious and dare to speak up or push back.
• Able to delegate tasks efficiently without losing visibility, ownership and control.
• Steady rock in times of ambiguity and tight deadlines.
• Ambitious, gritty and resilient. Live for the hustle and enjoy a fast-paced environment.
• Quality standards are high and you motivate the bigger team to raise the bar non stop.

Who We Are

Worldwide Clinical Trials (Worldwide), a leading global contract research organization (CRO), works in partnership with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies to create customized solutions that advance new medications – from discovery to reality. Anchored in our company’s scientific heritage, our dedicated therapeutic focus on cardiovascular, metabolic, neuroscience, oncology, and rare diseases, is applied to develop flexible plans and solve problems quickly for our customers.

Our talented team of 3,000+ professionals spans 60+ countries. We are united in cause with our customers to improve the lives of patients through new and innovative therapies. **

Why Worldwide**

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all... backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us! **

What Project Management Does At Worldwide**

Worldwide Clinical Trials Project management is the perfect blend of operational rigor and therapeutic expertise, with a client-focused approach. Our Global Project Leads (GPLs) and Clinical Project Managers (CPMs) expertly guide our project teams to deliver with high quality, focusing on “doing it right the first time”.

The Project Management team is engaged in all aspects of the trial collaborating with scientific and therapeutic leadership, coordinating across project teams, and providing flexible, innovative and proactive solutions. At Worldwide, you will be dedicated to a specific therapeutic area which will not only give you an opportunity to develop in depth global operational expertise, but also benefit from exceptional scientific and medical background that our experts bring. **

What You Will Do**
• Project Manager (PM) is responsible for the overall coordination and management of clinical trials from start up through closeout activities.
• Directs the technical, financial and operational aspects of the projects -- thus securing the successful completion of clinical trials.
• Works with functional area leads to identify and evaluate fundamental project requirements, interpret data on complex issues, is responsible for contingency planning and implementation of rescue strategy where needed and ensure solutions are implemented.
• Works to ensure that all project deliverables meet the customer’s time/quality/cost expectations
• The PM, with support from the Project Management Directors, working in collaboration with other functional area leads, is accountable for ensuring that all project deliverables meet the customer/contract expectations

What You Will Bring To The Role
• Experience in managing projects in a multi-office environment
• Ability to handle multiple competing priorities and utilize resources effectively
• Inspire effective teamwork and motivate staff within a matrix system, lead by example and encourage team members to seek solutions
• Excellent communication, planning and organizational skills
• Self-motivated and excellent problem-solving skills
• Ability to negotiate and liaise with clients in a professional manner

Your Experience
• 5+ years' Clinical Project Management experience required within a CRO setting is preferred
• University/College degree, within Life Science is preferred
• Thorough knowledge of project management processes with a solid understanding of how to craft and manage a project budget
• Can demonstrate experience of successfully managing and/or leading multidisciplinary project teams
• Ability to travel when needed

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

To view our other roles, check out our careers page at www.worldwide.com/careers! For more information on Worldwide, visit www.Worldwide.com or connect with us on LinkedIn.

We’re a global, mid-size CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents — because the path to a cure for the world’s most persist diseases is not paved by those who play it safe, but by those who take pioneering, creative approaches, and implement them with quality and excellence. We are experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs, in the best possible way.

jobs_results.title: Civil Design & Works Package Leader (F/M)
jobs_results.description:
Job Description Summary
Gris System Integration (GSI) is in charge of delivering turnkey high voltage substation project involving all technologies. These integrated solutions enable large scale electrification and integration of green, sustainable renewable energy with a great sense of purpose

Job Description

Within GSI South Europe, the Civil Work Leader is responsible for the valuation of Civil Engineering & Civil works activities during the tender phase (ITO), . Acting under the direction of the tender leader, he covers all fields of Civil Engineering: earthworks, drainage, foundation, building, building services, …

During project execution (OTR) he/she is in charge of delivering the civil works scope of projects reporting to the project director and in coordination with all other project functions..

He ensures that Safety, Quality, Costs and Schedule comply with contractual obligations, company policy and local regulation.

In link with Sourcing & Procurement, he has major... contributions to the management of the portfolio of suppliers & sub-contractor in his field.

He reports to the GSI Construction Regional lead and participate to the function’s objective definitions and their follow up.

Network & Links:
• Internal: Project Director, Project Managers, Project engineering director, Plant engineering, Internal Project Design entities, Project Controller, Site Manager, Commissioning Manager, Site Eng/Supervisors.
• External: Customer, Subcontractors/partners, staffing agencies.

Major Responsibilities:

Health and Safety
• Demonstrate EHS leadership and ensure Safety by Design & STOP WORK policies are implemented.
• Ensures application of GE GRID EHS Policy and procedures in all activities.

Quality
• Maintain/update tools, templates, design books to be used in civil design/works activities within projects.
• Participate to continuous improvement actions of Design & Construction phases .
• Treatment of Non Conformities and Lessons Learned

Skills / Qualifications:
• Appropriate qualification in Civil Engineering, degree level with around 10 years of work experience.
• Appropriate health and safety experience, training and qualifications in line with international standards for roles of this nature.
• Great interpersonal skills & ability to lead working teams in complex organizations across countries.
• Ability to communicate effectively, and to accurately and concisely report both verbally and in writing.
• Proficiency in ENGLISH mandatory / Additional European language a plus
• Good level in CAD tools (Autocad, Revit & BIM platforms)
• Good IT proficiency including collaborative platforms & tools.

Experience:
• Direct experience in designing and/or delivering civil works for HV substations or similar industrial projects, preferably in European countries.

Knowledge:
• Valuation methodology of civil design/works.
• Key applicable standards and specifications associated with the civil works applicable for countries in the region.
• Environmental legislation and good industry practice in relation to construction works.
• Civil Design Outsourcing
• Design-Build contracting strategies.

Other:
• Office-based position - will require frequent travelling to suppliers & project sites across the region.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

jobs_results.title: PROJECT MANAGER (PROYECTO PARA MÉXICO)
jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres continuar desarrollarte profesionalmente como Project Manager en una empresa de ingeniería del sector automoción? ¿Te gustaría tener la posibilidad de trasladarte un tiempo a vivir a México y trabajar en proyectos de infraestructuras dentro de una reconocida compañía automovilística? Si es así, ¡Te estamos buscando!

Si buscas una compañía comprometida con su equipo humano que te aportará estabilidad y flexibilidad y cuyos valores son la calidad y excelencia, la honestidad y el compromiso con sus clientes, trabajadores y colaboradores. ¡Este es tu reto!

¿Qué te aportará esta posición?

Estabilidad: Únete a un equipo consolidado, reconocido y en continuo crecimiento, asegurando tu estabilidad laboral con un proyecto de un año con posibilidad de prórroga

Atractivo proyecto profesional: Te encargarás de gestionar proyectos estratégicos de gran envergadura y de última generación del sector de la automoción, uno de los sectores más avanzados, participando en proyectos sensibles... y novedosos.

Gran Calidad y Excelencia: Para nosotros, la excelencia es una máxima. Nuestros proyectos son muy exigentes en cuanto a acabados, calidad en los materiales y tenemos una obsesión por la seguridad, la calidad y la limpieza. Además, somos una empresa con procedimientos y estándares profesionalizados.

Dinamismo: Participarás en un trabajo dinámico, lo que te permitirá desarrollarte profesionalmente en un entorno complejo y tener un perfil profesional mucho más completo.

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Te responsabilizarás de llevar el control de varias obras, coordinando a los equipos de trabajo que tengas en cada obra bajo tu responsabilidad.

Serás la persona responsable de la comunicación con el cliente y la ejecución de las obras y el control de seguridad, planificando, coordinando, supervisando y vigilando el cumplimiento de calidad, costes y plazos correspondientes.

Tus funciones serán:
• Planificación del proyecto.
• Gestión de recursos.
• Supervisión y control.
• Comunicación y coordinación.
• Gestión de costes y presupuesto.
• Gestión de calidad.
• Gestión de seguridad.

¿Qué te hará triunfar en esta posición?

Para tener éxito en este rol, nos gustaría que tuvieses estudios relacionados con Ingeniería o Arquitectura, aunque no descartaremos otros perfiles que vengan de otras ramas, pero con experiencia, conocimientos y capacidad de gestionar este tipo de proyectos de infraestructura.

Lo más importante, tú y tus ganas de desarrollarte en el sector y tus capacidades para sacar adelante los proyectos. Pensamos que lo mejor para triunfar sería tener experiencia de al menos tres años realizando las tareas anteriores como Project manager.

Estamos en la búsqueda de personas apasionadas y comprometidas, con una clara orientación al cliente, destrezas innatas en la gestión de equipos y un liderazgo que inspire. Te invitamos a sumergirte en un proyecto desafiante y enriquecedor.

Si buscas incorporarte a una compañía en la que desarrollar este atractivo proyecto profesional, ¡Esta posición es para ti!

¿Quieres hacer tuyo nuestro proyecto? ¡Te estamos esperando!

Envía tu CV y estaremos encantados de conocerte
